name: Adjusting
overview: The Bible teaches that adjusting in the Christian life involves a conscious transformation of the mind and body to align with God's will. Believers are called to offer themselves as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which represents a reasonable act of worship. This transformation includes resisting conformity to worldly patterns and embracing the renewal of the mind to discern God's perfect will. Additionally, faith provides the confidence to live by what is unseen, rejoicing in the relationship with Christ, the bridegroom, as those who hear and respond to His voice.
